detail: Best Budget accommodation in the Island.

name: Boracay Ocean Club Beach Resort
detail: Boracay is definitely a great place for a short honeymoon, or a beach holiday. The people are all super friendly and both my husband and I enjoyed ourselves. The Ocean Club was by far one of the best resorts located along the quieter side of the beach in Boracay. Free beach towels and beach chairs for uninterrupted and peaceful sunset viewing. Although walking back from the main parts of the beach might be a long way, but we always enjoyed these walks along the stretch of beautiful beach. The resort itself was super clean and the staff are all wonderful. Super polite and efficient. Buffet Dinners are the best !!!! BBQ menus are wonderful, and super affordable. The Breakfast spread is also very delectable, I particularly loved that the restaurant set up an egg station. LOVED IT. The resort also can help arrange for transportation (with Island Star or Southwest), from Kalibo Airport at a good price. Other than that! My husband and I are looking forward to go back to Boracay, and we will definitely be staying at The Ocean Club!

name: Happiness Hostel Boracay
detail: Plus the yoga/gym room and some board games for the bored 😊

name: Fairways and Bluewater Boracay
detail: We rented a kayak suggested by the staff at the savoy hotel side of the beach the sister company of fairways. The paddle broke midway without hitting any rocks. We were at the deep part of the water. Our safety had been compromised and the manager made us pay 5000 pesos for the paddle even though it wasn't our fault. The manager robbie and his people were very rude talking to us as if we were criminals. Never in my life have I been treated like this in any of the hotels I have stayed. The manager also insisted that he wanted cash and credit card was not allowed . We were suspicious so we only told him we will pay in card only and he got angry. In the end it was resolved by another manager which allowed us to pay in credit card and lower the amount to 5000 which is still very high(original amount asking is 6000). Very scam worthy. Would not recommend to anyone ever

name: Aqua Boracay
detail: Been to boracay several times before and had some problem/issues with previous hotels we’d stayed that’s why there’s hesitation going back... but still we want to see the new boracay after rehabilitation, and found this new hotel.... very friendly receptionist and all the staff, so helpful with our queries and accommodating with our requests.... my nieces and nephew loves it so much, saying the best hotel they’ve stayed in boracay... only the con, no service/shuttle going to dmall(though you can walk going there, almost half km) but they are working on it since they are only in soft opening... nice ambiance, spacious room, great facilities and services, and of course the kids love the pool and the beach (low tide in the afternoon, so enjoying it in the morning)... special mention to Ms Joy, Ms Jessa and Mr Marc (receptionists) and our room housekeeper Razel - kudos to them for making us at home. Til our next stay ;)

name: Movenpick Resort & Spa Boracay
detail: It’s my first time to stay in a Movenpick hotel/resort and I was completely blown by their overall amenities and service. All the staff and crew were polite and friendly, the rooms are new and always clean, the food is also very good (no need to go outside of the resort!), the beach bar has amazing music and cocktails, the chocolate hour was a nice surprise (we liked the coconut chocolate!), the spa is divine, and of course, the view of the sunset is unparalleled. It may not have the best sands of the White Beach in the popular area of Boracay but to me, their beach is better because it’s not crowded as only the guests are around. Considering the state of Boracay currently, going out will be really a challenge and their topnotch amenities are really a blessing to our vacation. When we needed to go out, they have a reliable shuttle service that you can take that will save you from all the hassles of commuting in the dusty road (the roads in Boracay are under construction). Excellent!

name: Savoy Hotel Boracay near Newcoast Beach
detail: Thank you Savoy Boracay! My family and I had such an exceptional stay in Savoy Boracay. Everyone was so accomodating, friendly, warm, and always had a sincere smile on their faces. We went to Boracay to celebrate our daughter’s birthday and the guest service associate Jess arranged a complimentary birthday cake for her upon our arrival. Mich and Patricia were so helpful in arranging our room accommodation that would cater to my family’s need. The view in our room was breathtaking.! When we entered our room, the front staff (Patricia, Carmela, Uriah, Yam) surprised her with a birthday song, balloon, and cake. My daughter was so happy! The hotel pool is a good alternative to relax after a long day of exploring the island. The private beach is beautiful. It might not be as lively and exciting as the white sand beach in station 1,2,3 but it is clean, and safe. You can also go for kayaking or go for a quick and relaxing swim. We truly had a wonderful stay in Savoy Boracay!

name: Henann Regency Resort And Spa
detail: we were on vacation because of my recent birthday that i celebrated in Boracay Regency Hotel and Spa...i only made a internet surfing for low cost hotels in boracay suddenly i choosed this Boracay Regency Hotel and Spa...which i choosed the right hotel for our family vacation also...it was a great honor to be celebrated my birthday in this hotel, the staff were all friendly and nice..the breakfast, lunch and dinner were all good...the island hopping for our activities that the hotel introduced to us were differently to the other activities we took before...the facilities of this hotel were also great...yes, the cleanliness, the ambiance, the facilities, the service were so good, from they took us to Caticlan airport to the speed boat until we reach the beautiful hotel, the staffs, they all knew what their guest wants...this Boracay Regency Hotel and Spa is one of the hotels, that the Philippines proud of...tourism industry in the philippines will be known evrywhere because of this HOTEL...
